item.title: Vintage Market Days returns to Hoover with three days of shopping, food and DIY fun
item.description: Vintage Market Days brings its upscale, vintage-inspired market to the Finley Center in Hoover with more than 125 vendors, food trucks, workshops and special early shopping hours.

item.title: On the right track: Bumpus 8th grader breaking records, turning heads
item.description: Eighth grader Reese Gonzalez stunned the state cross-country field, winning a 5K title with a sub-18 time while running for Hoover High, becoming the school’s first female state champion.

item.title: Test your luck at bingo night at the Hoover Public Library
